description:
Merge staged rows into one pending row: N same-pair trades (split fills of one order, e.g. a TWAP) or one outgoing + one incoming one-sided leg

Two shapes. (1) Every leg is a pending staged two-legged trade (row_type 'transaction') with the same from/to asset ids and kind: any number (>= 2) fold into one pending trade; amounts and values sum (value is null if any fill has none), tx_date is the latest fill's, note is the first non-empty one. (2) Exactly two one-sided legs, one outgoing (-) and one incoming (+), at least one staged: same ticker becomes a transfer (basis carries over), else a swap. Merged staged rows get status 'merged' and cannot be restored. The result stays pending: confirm it with /api/review/confirm. Returns {id, kind} plus combined (row count) for shape 1. (POST /api/review/merge)

source.description: 'staged' = a review-queue row; 'adjustment' = a live position adjustment (shape 2 only)
